lato.label: Lato
lato.description: A warm humanist sans-serif used by many modern resume and CV templates.

ptsans.label: PT Sans
ptsans.description: A clean, neutral sans-serif that reads well on screen and in print.

ptserif.label: PT Serif
ptserif.description: A refined transitional serif, a good match for academic and executive documents.

academic-writing.label: Academic writing pack
academic-writing.description: Research and grant proposals, literature reviews, statements of purpose, letters of recommendation, white papers, and theses.

beamer-themes.label: Beamer theme collection
beamer-themes.description: Madrid, Warsaw, Berkeley, Singapore, Copenhagen, Frankfurt, Boadilla, and Pittsburgh beamer decks.

business-documents.label: Business documents
business-documents.description: Invoices, memos, meeting minutes, business plans and reports, certificates, and a trifold brochure.

conference-preprints.label: Conference preprint styles
conference-preprints.description: NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, CVPR, AAAI, IJCAI, Springer LNCS, JMLR, arXiv, and Interspeech style preprints.

coursework.label: Coursework pack
coursework.description: Homework, worksheets, quizzes, rubrics, lecture notes, syllabi, math reference sheets, exams, and pseudocode writeups.

creative-misc.label: Creative & miscellaneous
creative-misc.description: Recipe books, invitations, RPG character sheets, a year calendar, table and TikZ galleries, and field notes.

cv-collection.label: CV & resume style collection
cv-collection.description: ModernCV, AltaCV, Awesome-CV, Europass, Friggeri, Plasmati, Twenty Seconds, and Jake's-style resumes.

reports-lab.label: Lab & technical reports
reports-lab.description: Lab reports, scientific and technical reports, project and internship reports, and an annual report.

resume-plus.label: Resume & CV expansion
resume-plus.description: Two-column tech resume, minimal resume, long-form academic CV, cover letter, and a Typst CV.

slides-posters.label: Slides & posters
slides-posters.description: Metropolis beamer deck, tikzposter portrait and landscape, and a better-poster layout.

venue-classes.label: Journal & conference classes
venue-classes.description: REVTeX, ACS achemso, Elsevier, ACM sigconf, and Typst journal starters.
